title: Your edits stay put when you switch windows
summary: Switching to another window or another seat acting no longer puts back what the DM was typing, saving a form keeps it open with its confirmation, and a failed account check on reload no longer locks you out of your campaign.
items: Item edits (name, notes), a purse's coin amounts and NPC service ticks keep what you typed until you save or cancel.
Saving NPC barter rules, downtime hours, property, staff, supplier, rent, postal, ship and dock settings keeps the section open and shows that it was recorded.
If the account check fails when you open or reload the app, your own campaign stays open with a Retry notice and the account is checked again when you reconnect.
Clear wait in NPC barter activity now says why when it cannot clear.
Reloading a shared campaign no longer sends Player joined or Mode changed notifications.
